summary.name: Google SRE Resource Library
summary.one_liner: Google's SRE resource library, a curated collection of site reliability engineering learning paths, books, videos and materials, anchored by the book Site Reliability Engineering.
use_cases: Learning site reliability engineering from scratch
Finding curated SRE books and videos
Following a structured SRE learning path
Understanding how Google runs large systems reliably
Applying SRE practices in an organization
Reading about reliability in cloud and AI systems
summary.what_it_does: The page is a resource library for site reliability engineering, offering curated learning paths, SRE books, videos and other materials for all experience levels. It highlights the book Site Reliability Engineering, a rewritten edition by Google SRE team members (Betsy Beyer, Chris Jones, Christof Leng, David Huska, Jennifer Petoff and Niall Richard Murphy). The book describes Google's current SRE practices and how they have changed over the decade since the first edition. The featured edition adds updates on the value of reliability, cloud reliability, and the impact of AI. The material is presented as applicable to making large systems scalable, reliable and efficient in other organizations.
notable: Curated SRE learning paths for all levels
Features the rewritten Site Reliability Engineering book from Google's SRE team
New edition covers cloud reliability and the impact of AI
caveats: Pricing and access terms for the resources are not stated on the page
